portInfo.description: The Port of Bordeaux sits on the Gironde estuary and Garonne with seven specialised port terminals handling nearly a thousand ships a year. Its maritime and river cruise page distinguishes three cruise terminals — Bordeaux, Pauillac and Le Verdon — and publishes a traffic snapshot of 64 calls and 67,000 passengers. Le Verdon-sur-Mer is described as a true deep-water port for large ships; smaller river pontoons extend calls to towns along the estuary and river including Royan, Blaye, Bourg-sur-Gironde, Cussac-Fort-Médoc, Libourne and Cadillac. Cruise passengers must read their berthing letter: a city pontoon day and a Verdon day are different itineraries.
